components.name: Ideation Core
components.description: Backend service for brainstorming facilitation, session management, and nugget crystallization. Transforms raw intent into refined understanding ready for planning.

components.name: Ideation UI
components.description: Frontend application for human-initiated brainstorming sessions with Interviewer agent and real-time specialist observations.

components.name: Planner Core API
components.description: Backend service providing REST API, MCP tools, domain model, and storage for plan management

components.name: Planner UI
components.description: Frontend application for plan creation, editing, approval workflow, and execution visibility

components.name: Tuner
components.description: Adaptive learning loop that observes Forge outcomes, builds baselines, detects drift, and learns optimal model selection via Thompson sampling. CLI-only, no UI.

components.name: Forge Core
components.description: Orchestration engine for plan execution with budget enforcement, model selection, recovery strategies, and Tuner integration. Executes plans from Planner with observability via Trajectories.

components.name: Testbench
components.description: End-to-end pipeline testing for Planner → Forge → Tuner. Runs predefined scenarios, collects metrics, supports training mode for Tuner learning. CLI-only.

components.name: tend
components.description: Unified AI-native workspace merging ideation-ui, planner-ui, and forge-ui into a single three-column layout (The Now / Conversation / The Tree). Forked from ideation-ui. Earth-tone zen garden aesthetic.

components.name: Mull
components.description: Cross-agent, cross-session shared memory. Extracts the 5-10% of session data that is actual knowledge and writes structured markdown topic files to memory/. Generic core with adapter pattern — reads from trajectory files, relay logs, transcripts, or any custom source. Two-stage pipeline: deterministic extraction ($0) + selective LLM synthesis. Built portable for standalone extraction.

components.name: Cultivate
components.description: Signal intake and processing system. Watches external channels, filters through three tiers (rules → local ML → LLM), scores with 8 weighted factors, clusters via grounded theory, and surfaces what matters. Greenhouses control focus. Tuner manages weights. No fallbacks — fail fast everywhere.

features.title: Mull: Cross-Agent Shared Memory
features.note: Generic knowledge extraction pipeline. Two-stage: deterministic ($0) + LLM synthesis. Writes topic files to memory/. Built portable for standalone extraction.

features.title: Core Type System & Schemas
features.note: Zod schemas: SessionData, Message, SessionEvent, Decision, Retrospective, Artifact, Entity, Fact, TopicMatch, Nugget, PreExtract, MergeResult. SessionAdapter interface.

features.title: Adapter Orchestration System
features.note: createAdapter factory, multi-adapter merge by timestamp, cursor persistence in .mull/, config validation, session listing across adapters.

features.title: Built-in Generic Adapters
features.note: 3 adapters: trajectory-file (.trajectory.json with chapters/events/retrospective/artifacts), relay-jsonl (YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl), transcript (md/jsonl/txt). Each implements SessionAdapter with cursor tracking.

features.title: Deterministic Extraction Layer
features.note: 4 functions: extractEntities (compromise.js + tech lexicon), extractFacts (structural from events), matchTopics (vs memory/ filenames + tags), filterTranscript (decision-adjacent only). Composes into PreExtract. $0, <100ms.

features.title: LLM Synthesis Layer
features.note: Prompt construction from PreExtract, single Haiku call, structured nugget parsing, trail decision shortcut (bypass LLM), Tier 0 fallback (no API key). ~$0.001-0.004/session.

features.title: Topic File System & Index Generation
features.note: Markdown + YAML frontmatter (gray-matter). Slug-based merge (never duplicate). Sections: Decisions/Constraints/Patterns/Gotchas/Context. rebuildTOC after every write. readTopicFile for extraction layer.

features.title: Pipeline Orchestrator
features.note: Wires stages: load → extract → synthesize → merge → toc. mull() and mullAll() functions. Incremental processing, idempotency, dry-run, partial failure recovery, config resolution.

features.title: CLI Interface
features.note: commander-based. mull <session-id>, --all, --source, --dir, --dry-run, --force, --memory-dir. Config loading (mull.config.json → package.json → flags). Progress output. Exit codes. bin entry.

features.title: Mull Plannr Integration
features.note: SQLite adapters for planner.db + forge.db, relay daemon adapter, server plugin at /api/mull, real-time event triggers.

features.title: Planner DB Trajectory Adapter
features.note: Reads DecisionEvents from planner.db trajectory_events. Sessions by plan_id. Maps question_text + selected_option + reasoning → Decision. Cursor per plan_id.

features.title: Forge DB Trajectory & Retrospective Adapter
features.note: Reads 40+ TrajectoryEvent types (filtered to ~10 high-signal) + Retrospectives (approach, decisions[], learnings[], suggestions[]) + UserTrajectoryEvent + DerivedPreference from forge.db. Sessions by run_id.

features.title: Relay Daemon Storage Adapter
features.note: Reads from .agent-relay/ SQLite or JSONL with Envelope<T> parsing. Session reconstruction via agent lifecycle (spawn→release) or time windows. Agent/channel filtering.

features.title: Server Plugin Mount & REST API
features.note: createMullRouter() factory. POST /run, POST /run/all, GET /status, GET /topics, GET /topics/:slug. Non-blocking async. @plannr/errors.

features.title: Event-Driven Real-Time Triggers
features.note: Deterministic on decision_recorded/retrospective_recorded/chapter_start (<100ms inline). LLM batched on 3+ entities, 20-min timer, or session end (background). Entity accumulator per session.

features.title: Domain Types & Zod Schemas
features.note: Signal, Cluster, Greenhouse, Recommendation, ScoringFactors, CultivateWeights, CultivateConfig, CultivateOutcome, FilterRule, SourceConfig, IngestionJob, RawEvent, NormalizedEvent, ExtractionResult, StepProvenance, SignalSource, AuthConfig, AuthorType, AdapterType, SourcePreset, all enums. Model names configurable via CULTIVATE_EXTRACT_MODEL / CULTIVATE_CLUSTER_MODEL.

features.title: Error Types
features.note: CultivateStartupError (REDIS_UNAVAILABLE, DB_INIT_FAILED, ML_MODEL_LOAD_FAILED, ANTHROPIC_UNAVAILABLE), CultivateInternalError, SignalFilteredError, SignalProcessingError. All errors carry diagnostic context (what broke, why, how to fix).

features.title: SQLite Storage Layer
features.note: CultivateStorage interface + SqliteCultivateStorage extending BaseSqliteStorage. Tables: signals, greenhouses, clusters, source_configs, filter_rules, ingestion_jobs, cultivate_config + indexes. Full CRUD. Default Greenhouse auto-creation on initialize() when none exist (refinement mode, all sources, no keyword filters).

features.title: SSE Broadcaster (Shared Infrastructure)
features.note: SSEBroadcaster class as shared infrastructure — instantiated at startup, injected into pipeline, jobs, and API. NOT owned by API layer. Events: signal:new, signal:updated, cluster:new, cluster:updated, cluster:trending, ingestion:progress, ingestion:complete, source:error, source:auth_expired. Heartbeat every 30s. GET /events endpoint wires SSE to HTTP clients.

features.title: Credential Encryption
features.note: AES-256-GCM encrypt/decrypt for source credentials. Key derived from CULTIVATE_SECRET env var. Used by source config storage and adapter initialization.

features.title: Tier 0 + Tier 1 Filtering (Greenhouse Gate + Rule Registry)
features.note: Greenhouse keyword gate (Tier 0): keyword_require/keyword_exclude per Greenhouse. Rule Registry (Tier 1): FilterRule registry with default rules (noise_reject, bot_reject, length_check, specificity_boost, structure_boost, question_boost). Tuner-managed enable/disable and boost amounts. Effectiveness tracking (signals_matched, false_positive_rate). Greenhouse tier1_strictness gate.

features.title: Tier 2 Local ML Classification
features.note: Transformers.js zero-shot classifier (Xenova/mobilebert-uncased-mnli). loadClassificationModel() at startup — throws CultivateStartupError('ML_MODEL_LOAD_FAILED') on failure. First run downloads ~100MB model. tier2Filter() returns pass/fail + feedback_score + category_hint. Per-signal failure → job fails → BullMQ retry → dead letter. No fallback.

features.title: Tier 3 LLM Extraction (Sonnet)
features.note: Structured extraction via Sonnet (model configurable via CULTIVATE_EXTRACT_MODEL). Returns: summary, keywords, entities, aspects, quotes, reasoning, specificity, emotional_intensity, actionability. On failure: job fails → BullMQ retry → dead letter. No partial extraction stored.

features.title: Multi-Factor Scoring Engine
features.note: 8 factors: recency (exponential decay, 90-day half-life), specificity (from extraction), source_authority (channel_authority × author_multiplier + tier/mrr boosts), repetition (cross-source corroboration: diversity 0.45, count 0.30, velocity 0.25), emotional_intensity, strategic_fit (keyword overlap with Greenhouse boost list + active projects), actionability, content_quality (tier1_boost × 0.4 + tier2_score × 0.6). Weight resolution: Greenhouse overrides → Tuner config → mode defaults (refinement/discovery) → DEFAULT_WEIGHTS.

features.title: AI Cluster Assignment (Haiku)
features.note: Grounded theory clustering via Haiku (configurable via CULTIVATE_CLUSTER_MODEL). Assign to existing cluster or create new. Summary regeneration every 5th signal via Sonnet. Per-Greenhouse cluster space — clusters NEVER span Greenhouses (architectural invariant).

features.title: Deduplication (Exact + Near)
features.note: Exact dedup: source_type + external_id uniqueness before pipeline entry. Near dedup: after extraction, same cluster + >80% keyword overlap from same source type within 7 days → marked near_duplicate_of, original gets repetition boost.

features.title: Processing Pipeline Orchestration
features.note: Process-signal pipeline: Greenhouse gate (Tier 0) → Tier 1 rule filter → Tier 2 ML → Tier 3 Sonnet extract → Score → Near dedup → Cluster assign → Store → SSE broadcast. No partial signals — complete or dead-letter. Does NOT handle chunking (that is pre-pipeline in ingest-document worker).

features.title: Generic Adapter Types + Source Health Policy
features.note: 4 adapter types: PollApiAdapter (endpoint template with {cursor}/{since} placeholders, pagination, rate limiting, response mapping), WebhookAdapter (HMAC verification, path mounting under /api/cultivate/webhooks), PushAdapter (text/document/CSV/email, ChunkConfig with recursive/sentence/speaker_aware strategies), StructuredPullAdapter (query template, signal template, thresholds). All implement SourceAdapter interface. Source health escalation: 1 fail → warn, 3 → unhealthy + source:error SSE, 10 → disabled, auth error (401/403) → immediate disable + source:auth_expired.

features.title: All 30+ Source Presets
features.note: Factory functions producing complete adapter configs. SourcePreset: name, adapter_type, description, required_inputs, optional_inputs, defaults, channel_authority. Tier 1 (0.90-0.95): support_zendesk, support_intercom, support_email, surveys_nps, surveys_csat, interviews. Tier 2 (0.70-0.85): github_issues, github_discussions, appstore_ios, appstore_android, reviews_g2, reviews_capterra, reviews_trustradius, analytics_mixpanel, analytics_amplitude, analytics_posthog, in_app_feedback. Tier 3 (0.45-0.60): slack_channel, discord_channel, teams_channel, crm_hubspot, crm_salesforce, sales_calls. Tier 4 (0.25-0.40): reddit_subreddit, reddit_search, hackernews, twitter_search, rss_feed, web_monitor, competitor_reviews. Tier 5 (0.60): manual_paste, document_upload, csv_import, zapier_webhook.

features.title: BullMQ Job Queue System
features.note: 6 queues: poll-sources (concurrency 3, retry 3 exponential — worker calls adapter.poll(), exact dedup, per-Greenhouse fan-out: one process-signal job per matching Greenhouse), process-signal (concurrency 5, retry 2 — runs pipeline), ingest-document (concurrency 2, retry 1 — chunks then enqueues N process-signal jobs), recluster (weekly Sun 03:00 UTC), decay (daily 04:00 UTC), trend-detect (hourly). Dead letter for all failed jobs with diagnostic context.

features.title: Signal Decay + Trend Detection + Weekly Recluster
features.note: Decay: daily, 90-day half-life (Tuner-adjustable), linked signals exempt, reinforced signals reset recency, below 0.15 → 'decayed', recalculates cluster avg_relevance. Trends: hourly, weekly (0.7) + monthly (0.3) velocity per cluster, rising (>0.2)/stable/declining (<-0.2), emits cluster:trending SSE on transition to rising. Recluster: weekly via Sonnet, merge/split/rename review, regenerates affected summaries.

features.title: Recommendation Engine
features.note: generateRecommendations(): Top 15 clusters by avg_relevance × (1 + trend_velocity), min 2 signals. One Sonnet call → up to 5 ranked Recommendation[] with title, confidence, reasoning, evidence, cluster_id, greenhouse_id, trend, estimated_impact, overlaps_project. Cached 15 min, invalidated on high-relevance signal. Filterable by Greenhouse.

features.title: Tuner Integration
features.note: Config polling: GET /api/tuner/config/cultivate every 5 min — applies scoring_weights, rule_overrides, tier2_threshold, decay_half_life_days, author_multiplier, cluster_summary_interval. Outcome recording: POST /api/tuner/outcomes/cultivate on link/dismiss/ignore/started_project. Learning loop: link → boost, dismiss → dampen, ignore 30+ days → implicit not useful, filter rejection where near-duplicate later scores well → flag rule too aggressive. Falls back to hardcoded defaults on first run (only acceptable default).

features.title: REST API Layer
features.note: createCultivateRouter(deps). Greenhouses CRUD, Signals CRUD + link/dismiss (records CultivateOutcome via Tuner), Clusters read, Sources CRUD, Presets catalog, Ingestion + status, Recommendations, Filter rules CRUD, Dead letter (list/replay/replay-all/discard — needs BullMQ queue access), Webhooks receiver, SSE endpoint (GET /events). All inputs Zod-validated.

features.title: Fail-Fast Startup Sequence
features.note: startCultivate(config): 1. Redis → CultivateStartupError('REDIS_UNAVAILABLE'), 2. SQLite + migrations → ('DB_INIT_FAILED'), 3. Transformers.js model → ('ML_MODEL_LOAD_FAILED'), 4. Anthropic verifyAccess() → ('ANTHROPIC_UNAVAILABLE'), 5. Tuner config (hardcoded defaults on first run), 6. SSE broadcaster, 7. BullMQ queues + workers, 8. Scheduled jobs. createCultivateService() wraps in plugin pattern: { router, initialize, shutdown }. Graceful shutdown: stop workers, close queues, close Redis, close SQLite.

features.title: Server Integration
features.note: Env vars: CULTIVATE_DB_PATH, CULTIVATE_SECRET, CULTIVATE_REDIS_URL, CULTIVATE_EXTRACT_MODEL, CULTIVATE_CLUSTER_MODEL. Import createCultivateService, initialize(), mount at /api/cultivate. Graceful shutdown. Add @huggingface/transformers, bullmq, ioredis to package.json. Update dev.sh for Redis.
